scope_note: Pins the first measurement this program has ever made of sieve-produced dual vectors, before independent review. It asserts NOTHING about whether the dual-attack cost models' independence law holds: no comparison against MATZOV.Nf was performed and the producer states no finding, by contract. Reduced-dimension measurement (dim 60, q=127) is NOT crypto-scale evidence and says nothing about FIPS 203. No ML-KEM break, no security proof, no parameter set affected or cleared. Rule 12 UNMET and UNWAIVED; EV-MLKEM-015 and every KN-* entry unchanged.
what_the_producer_self_reported_against_: Dual vectors (x,y) are NOT in raw_scores.json -- only norms, phases and scores -- so a reviewer cannot score a candidate of their own choosing directly from the JSON without re-running. Recommended as a batch-2 fix.
Two failures in rebuild_transcript.txt are the producer's own coding errors, not instrument failures, and were kept verbatim rather than edited out.
DECAY_uniform_error's 'rank 1 of 5' at mean +0.009 is UNINFORMATIVE with 4 wrong candidates at noise level and must not be read as residual signal.

Reproduction is bit-identical in CONTENT but not in sha256: re-running with identical seeds gives identical vectors and arrays, with five wall-clock timing leaves differing. Content equality is the reproduction identity here, not the hash.
